messages.subject: For Ho Sung Song | Mobility, government relations and global stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Kia Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Ho Sung Song, President and Chief Executive Officer.

Kia's global transformation across electrification, manufacturing and international growth requires disciplined alignment across governments, regulators, communities and strategic partners. That interface closely matches my current leadership mandate.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory, with senior institutional engagement across complex regulated operations.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of government relations, sustainability and emerging-market stakeholder execution might support Kia's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Kia Corporation.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
